description_full:
CALL FOR INTERNS: CREATIVE DESIGNER!

Suara.com lagi cari creative minds buat gabung bareng tim! Punya skill desain, suka eksplor ide visual, dan gak takut revisi? This is your chance!

Periode magang: Des 2026 – Mar 2027

Paid internship

Kirim CV + portofolio ke recruitment@suara.com
Subject: Creative Design Intern [Jogja/Jakarta] – Nama Kamu

Deadline: 20 November 2026.

Tag temen desainermu yang wajib tau info ini!
